description_en: Modifies the SSL configurations of an AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) cluster
description_zh: 调用ModifyDBClusterSSL接口修改集群的SSL链路配置
kebab_example: aliyun adb modify-db-cluster-ssl --db-cluster-id am-bp1r053byu48p0000 --enable-ssl true --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBClusterSSL

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the IDs of AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition clusters within a region
parameters.help_zh:
AnalyticDB MySQL数仓版集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看数仓版集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable SSL encryption. Valid values:

true
false
parameters.help_zh:
开启或关闭SSL，取值：

true：开启
false: 关闭
parameters.name: enable_ssl

parameters.help_en: The internal or public endpoint for which the server certificate needs to be created or updated
parameters.help_zh: 需要创建或更新服务器证书的内网或外网连接地址
parameters.name: connection_string
